name: WING'D — Porter delivery relay
_README: Import this into n8n (Workflows > Import from File), then do FOUR things:
1. Open the 'Porter config' node and set PORTER_BASE and the three paths from the
API documentation Porter emails you when they issue credentials. I could NOT
verify Porter's exact endpoint paths, request bodies or auth header — porter.in/api-docs
blocks automated access. Do not trust the placeholder values below; replace them.
2. Create an n8n credential (Header Auth) holding the Porter API key and attach it to
the two 'Porter …' HTTP Request nodes. The key must never leave n8n.
3. Activate the workflow, copy the two Production webhook URLs, and paste them into
menu.json > porter.quoteUrl and porter.orderUrl. Set porter.enabled to true.
4. Give Porter the /porter-status webhook URL so rider status updates land back here.
Verified from porter.in/api-integrations (Aug 2026): Porter exposes Get Quote,
Create Order and Track Order APIs; the Create Order response contains a tracking link;
Track Order is rate limited to once per minute per order; webhooks fire on Accepted,
Live, Ended, Reopened and Cancelled; only 2-wheelers are bookable via API; one pickup
and one drop per order; pickup and drop must be sent as latitude/longitude.

nodes.name: Porter config — FILL THESE IN
nodes.notes: Endpoint paths are placeholders. Copy the real ones from the Porter API documentation supplied with your credentials.

parameters.url: ={{ $('Porter config — FILL THESE IN').first().json.PORTER_BASE + $('Porter config — FILL THESE IN').first().json.PATH_QUOTE }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ pickup_details: { lat: $('Webhook — quote').first().json.body.pickup.lat, lng: $('Webhook — quote').first().json.body.pickup.lng }, drop_details: { lat: $('Webhook — quote').first().json.body.drop.lat, lng: $('Webhook — quote').first().json.body.drop.lng }, customer: { mobile: { country_code: '+91', number: $('Webhook — quote').first().json.body.pickup.contact } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Body shape is a best guess and MUST be checked against Porter's documentation. Attach the Header Auth credential holding the Porter API key.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: 'WINGD-' + Date.now(), delivery_instructions: { instructions_list: [{ type: 'text', description: ($('Webhook — create order').first().json.body.items || []).map(i => i.qty + 'x ' + i.name + (i.size ? ' (' + i.size + ')' : '')).join(', ').slice(0, 200) }] }, pickup_details: { address: $('Webhook — create order').first().json.body.pickup }, drop_details: { address: $('Webhook — create order').first().json.body.drop } }) }}
